execution.description: Scripted the construction block into every pipeline record.

expected: Every existing record gains a construction block and keeps everything else.
observed: The script wrote battery's record as if new and replaced its notes and EV1, EV2, EV4 and admission prior work. The diff review caught it; the record was restored from git.
keep: Read the full diff of every record before committing.
change: Record writers merge into the existing record and refuse to replace one; never assume a record file is new.
